Subject: Plan: July 28 webinar — invite cadence, target segments, tracking

Hi team,

High level: we have the July 28 webinar ("Practical levers to reduce LLM inference cost") landing page + Zoom set up. Goals: 1) 400 registrants, 2) 120 qualify as product-fit (mid-market / enterprise), 3) 30 sales-qualified meetings booked within 30 days.

I drafted an invite cadence and segment targets attached (see 20260720-Webinar-Invite-Cadence-v1.docx and Audience CSV). Please review and confirm:
- Audience buckets: Current customers (Dedicated/Private), PQL trialers (hosted API), MQLs in fintech vertical, invited partners.
- Cadence: initial invite, 1 reminder (48h), last-chance (6h), 24h post-webinar recording + CTA.
- Tracking: UTM parameters per segment + HubSpot campaign tag HS:campaign:78321.

Aisha — can you take lead on the outbound copy and tracking links? Aditya — please confirm segmented lists and any exclusion rules (e.g., contacts who attended a webinar last 60 days). Neha — we'll need a short sales playbook for sales to reach registrants who mark "interested in a demo" on registration.

Also looping Rachel at Streamline for recommended RSVP reminder timing for APAC overlap.

Thanks,
Vanessa

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com

Looks good — appended copy suggestions below and a proposed schedule for send times (US-focused):

Proposed send schedule (US):
- Tue Jul 21 10:30 AM PT — initial invite (subject test A/B: “How top teams cut inference costs 2x”)
- Thu Jul 23 10:30 AM PT — reminder (content: 3 bullets — what you'll learn, speakers, CTA)
- Mon Jul 27 4:00 PM PT — last chance (short, personalize with company name)
- Thu Jul 29 9:00 AM PT — recording + CTA (for registrants and non-attendees)

UTM and tracking: please use utm_campaign=jul28_inference, utm_source=email, utm_medium=invite, utm_content={segment}. Example: https://zoom.us/meeting/register/abcd-1234?utm_campaign=jul28_inference&utm_source=email&utm_medium=invite&utm_content=fintech

Attached quick subject line variants and two body lengths (short and long). For streamlining, I'm adding {{first_name}} and company tokens and an early RSVP link that sets a custom property in HubSpot so Sales can filter.

Quick copy snippet (short):
Hi {{first_name}},
Cut inference cost without sacrificing latency — join our July 28 workshop where engineers from Redwood and partners will demo batching, cache, and quantization strategies used in production.
Register: <tracking link>

--
Aisha

Thanks — reviewed the Audience CSV and made two edits. Notes below and exclusion logic.

Edits:
- Segment: move "Trial: high-token-usage" into PQL bucket if >3 sessions in last 14 days. These have high propensity.
- Exclude: anyone who attended a Redwood webinar in last 60 days OR who has an open SDR outreach sequence in HubSpot.

HubSpot workflow IDs: add HS:workflow:5402 to exclusion criteria (this prevents double outreach). Also adding a dynamic list for "Fintech Enterprise - engaged last 30 days". Export filename: 20260720-Audience-Segments.csv (attached).

For tracking links, prefer one canonical Zoom reg link with UTM variations handled by link shortener. I'll create a Rebrandly link per segment and add to the Drive doc. Rebrandly template example: https://rbrd.ly/jul28-fintech

Finally, small ask for Sales playbook: if an attendee checks "interested in demo", auto-create HS:deal:temp tag and route to Neha's team for outreach within 48 hours.

-Aditya
